name: Golden Cross 20/50
note: Enters long when the 20-period average price crosses above the 50-period average, taking the crossover as a signal of a new uptrend.

name: RSI Dip Buy
note: Buys when the 14-period RSI drops below 30, treating that as an oversold dip worth buying.

name: Volatility Contraction Trend
note: Enter long when short-term volatility contracts below long-term volatility while price holds above a rising 50-period trend average.
